title: Contribution Cushion on Seller Closing Contributions
content:
Contribution cushion (Payoff and Loan Satisfaction) — clause and cases

**Clause.** On the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record, the contribution cushion forms part of the seller closing contribution. The contribution cushion is per diem collected in advance against funds being credited after the statement's good-through date, and whatever of it is not needed for that per diem is refunded with the held excess. It is the per diem the payoff case carries times the plan's late-funds tolerance of 5 calendar days when the loan's maturity case, under the Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases product, is referred to foreclosure, and the flat USD 100.00 extension cushion when the maturity case is in its extension period; a case in any other status takes no cushion (0.00).

**Cases.** *Hypothetical:* with a per diem of USD 41.20 on the case, a maturity case referred to foreclosure gives a cushion of USD 206.00 (5 days); a case in its extension period gives USD 100.00 whatever the per diem; a due-and-payable case gives none.

**Basis question.** *Is the cushion kept in full?* No; it is kept only for the per diem the case owes for each day its funds were credited after the good-through date, and the unused part is refunded with the held excess.
